geometry_policy: Exact vertex coordinates, polygon indices and polygon normals preserved; UV only. Existing Blender Y bake remains unchanged.
wood_mapping: Each connected wood component: PCA longest axis is V/grain direction. Side U follows continuous rectangular perimeter with seam unwrap, caps use local orthogonal planar UV. Seeded offsets vary phase.
overlap_padding_policy: Intentional repeating tile coordinates; no unique atlas claimed. Perimeter seams and endcaps are separate islands; no atlas padding needed. Texture mirror addressing supplies continuous boundary values.
